ticker_news.title: Arista Earnings: AI Wave Keeps Rolling
ticker_news.description: Arista Networks surpassed Cisco Systems in the data center switch market, driven by strong demand from cloud computing giants investing in artificial intelligence infrastructure. Arista reported solid Q4 results, but growth is expected to slow slightly in 2025 despite the AI boom.
ticker_news.author: The Motley Fool

ticker_news.title: Massive News for Meta Platforms Stock Investors
ticker_news.description: The article discusses recent updates affecting Meta Platforms (META) and potential stock splits in 2025 for two AI stocks that have seen significant gains since early 2023.
ticker_news.author: Jose Najarro
